### How it works
Helps WooCommerce shops answer "where is my parcel?" before customers ask. When an order changes to completed, the workflow puts the customer's phone number in international format, builds the tracking link and sends an RCS card with a **Track my parcel** button. Phones that cannot receive RCS get an SMS with the tracking link.

**Limits:** RCS only reaches French mobile operators. The phone number conversion only knows French numbers. WooCommerce reports every change of an order, so a completed order changed again sends a new message.

### Setup
1. Install the verified **Bi-way** community node (`n8n-nodes-biway-messenger`, [instructions](https://github.com/pocket-communication/n8n-nodes-biway-messenger#installation)). Tested with 0.3.0 on n8n 2.45.4.
2. Create a **Bi-Way API** credential with an API key from Bi-way › Settings › Security.
3. Add a WooCommerce credential: the trigger creates the webhook in your shop when the workflow is published.
4. In **Build the tracking link**, replace `https://tracking.example.com/` with the tracking page of your carrier, or read the link your shipping plugin stores in the order.
5. RCS needs an agent launched by the French operators (check with RCS Agent › Get Status). Without one, set the Bi-way node to your SMS channel and Content to Text.
6. Complete a test order with your own number.

### Customization
Change the wording in **Send the shipping card**, and the country code in **Build the tracking link**. A fallback SMS written in the node holds 114 characters with the STOP mention and chat link; turn them off in **Fallback SMS Options** for up to 160.

## Keep completed orders
WooCommerce reports every change of an order: only completed ones go on.

## Build and send
French numbers such as 06 12 34 56 78 become +33612345678. The card goes by RCS, or an SMS on phones without RCS.
